title: Photo × Intaglio Study Poster
summary: Pair your photograph with a banknote-inspired intaglio reinterpretation, built from fine engraving, guilloche patterns, and textured paper. Adjust the format, comparison layout, paper and ink palette, and specimen lettering.
seoTitle: Photo × Intaglio Study Poster Prompt | Image Prompt Book
seoDescription: Turn a travel or portrait photo into an intaglio study poster with fine engraved lines and guilloche patterns. Customize the bilingual prompt and use it with your reference photo.
inputRequirement: Requires one reference photo. Attach it in your image generation tool; the prompt keeps a photographic panel and reinterprets the same subjects as intaglio art.
howToUse: Adjust the highlighted format, comparison layout, palette, and specimen-text options.
Copy the prompt, or open it directly in ChatGPT.
Attach your reference photo and send. The source does not specify a model or tool.
exampleNotice: These are four complete posters from the source, with a photograph beside its engraved interpretation. Changing options updates the prompt, not the examples.
verificationNotice: Image Prompt Book has not reproduced these examples. The model, generation settings, and standalone reference photos are not provided by the source.
adaptationNotice: The Chinese default preserves the source prompt exactly; the English version translates every sentence. Format, comparison layout, paper and ink colors, and specimen text are adjustable. Photo share, subject consistency, engraved linework, and the source’s specimen-only restrictions remain fixed. Added options are project adaptations, not author endorsements.
